subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 3: Vocabulary and Grammar (times of the day)
outcomes: I can name the times of the day.
I can ask and answer When do you ...?
I can use in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening and at night.

tf.s: We say at night, not in night.
tf.why: Yes! Night is different: at night.

tf.s: We see the moon at night.
tf.why: The moon is in the sky at night.

tf.s: The sun is setting in the morning.
tf.why: The sun sets in the evening.

tf.s: We go to school in the morning.
tf.why: Well done! School starts in the morning.

tf.s: We go to bed in the afternoon.
tf.why: We go to bed at night.

tf.s: We ask When do you have lunch? to know the time of the day.
We have lunch in the afternoon.
tf.why: Lunch is in the afternoon when the sun is high.

tf.s: We use in with afternoon: in the afternoon.

boxes.why: We see the moon at night.

boxes.q: Complete: We have dinner ___ the evening.
Complete: We go to bed ___ night.
Which is the first time of the day?
boxes.why: The day starts in the morning.

boxes.q: The sun is setting. What time of the day is it?
boxes.why: The sun sets in the evening.
We get up in the morning.

boxes.q: Which phrase does not use in?

mcq.q: Which are the four times of the day in order?
mcq.why: The day goes morning, afternoon, evening, night.

mcq.q: Which word do we use with night?
Which time of the day do we have lunch?
When do you go to school? Choose the full answer.
o: We go to school in the morning.
We go to school at night.
mcq.why: A full answer has We go to school in the morning.

mcq.q: Correct the mistake: We go to bed in night.
o: We go to bed at night.
We go to bed on night.
We go in bed at night.
We go to bed in the night at.

mcq.q: Complete: We have art lessons ___ the afternoon.
Which routine is in the wrong time?
o: We go to bed in the morning.
We have breakfast in the morning.
We have dinner in the evening.
We go to bed at night.
mcq.why: We go to bed at night, not in the morning.

mcq.q: Which two routines happen in the morning?
o: have dinner and go to bed
go to bed and get up
mcq.why: We get up and have breakfast in the morning.

mcq.q: Why is at night different from in the evening?
mcq.why: Morning, afternoon and evening use in; night uses at.
